claims.citation: New York Herald, 18 August 1866, p. 3, col. 2
claims.verbatim:
Ship "Figlia Jenny" (Aust), Srichia[?], Trieste, 77 days, with
mdse, to Howland & Aspinwall. Passed Gibraltar July 9;
Aug 15, lat 39 42, lon 68 19, sroke Austrian bark Giovanni P,
hence for Bristol (Eng), 1 day out.
